front: What is sdkmanager in one sentence?
back: Android SDK command-line package manager — install platforms, build-tools, NDK in headless CI without Android Studio.

front: Explain the mental model of sdkmanager (how the system thinks).
Symptom: Failed to install ... license not accepted — what do you check and fix?
Symptom: SDK location not found — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ANDROID_HOME, local.properties · Fix: Set env; sdk.dir= in local.properties

front: Symptom: Gradle: compileSdk not found — what do you check and fix?
Symptom: NDK build fails version mismatch — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ndkVersion in Gradle vs installed · Fix: sdkmanager --install "ndk;..." exact version

front: Symptom: Warning: Still waiting for package manager — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Stale lock / parallel jobs · Fix: Single sdkmanager process; clear .android locks

front: Symptom: Network fail in CI — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Proxy / Google repo · Fix: Mirror or cache SDK tarball; retry with timeout

front: Gotcha with sdkmanager: what silently fails?
back: Unpinned --update in CI — non-reproducible builds; pin platform + build-tools versions in pipeline YAML.

front: When should you NOT use sdkmanager?
back: Local dev with Android Studio — Studio SDK Manager UI is easier; same packages underneath. iOS builds — Xcode / xcodebuild, not sdkmanager. Installing arbitrary APKs on device — adb install, not sdkmanager.
